alate: Alate head width including the compound eyes about 1.25 mm, pronotum width 0.90–1.04 mm.
distribution: Sichuan, Henan, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Guizhou, Fujian, Taiwan, Yunnan, Guangdong and Guangxi.
soldier: Head orange-yellow or deep orange-red. Apart from several bristles on the anterior margin of the labrum, the body is almost entirely without hairs. Head rectangular, the sides slightly parallel, the two posterolateral margins and the posterior margin forming an arc; the brown median line of the head capsule is very conspicuous and extends forwards to about one-quarter of the length. The left mandible is strongly twisted, obliquely truncate on its anterior right side, the apex blunt; the right mandible slightly shorter and sabre-like. Labrum longer than wide, the anterior margin straight, the anterolateral corners shortly pointed. Antennae with 14 segments. The pronotum is narrower than the head, its anterior half vertically upturned, typically saddle-shaped.
taxonomy_note: Recorded in the original work as Pericapritermes jangtsekiangensis, now merged as a synonym into P. nitobei.
